chapter one · where it all began

Our little love story

And then, there was us...

16 November 2021

The day our story began

I didn't know then how much you would mean to me or how many beautiful memories we would make together.

Somewhere along the way

He fell first, I fell harder

Somehow, all the little conversations, silly moments and your smile became my favourite part of the day.

All the little things

Our own little world

The laughter, the teasing, the care, the random talks and even the smallest moments became special because they were with you.

Five years and counting

Still choosing you

You've been my biggest supporter, always standing by me. Thank you for making me feel loved and never making me feel alone.

“Five years down, forever to go. I still want all the little moments with you.” ♡

chapter four · from my heart

A letter from my heart

My Ankit, ♡

I don't think I can ever explain properly how much you mean to me. Thank you for always being there for me, supporting me and loving me the way you do.

You have been my biggest supporter, and I hope you know that I'll always be there for you too. I love taking care of you, being around you and sharing even the smallest moments with you.

I know we're not perfect, but I wouldn't trade our little world for anything. I just want us to keep growing together, laughing together and choosing each other every day.

With all my love, always. ♡
